'''Ragi dosa''' is a traditional food in Karnataka [[Cookbook:Cuisine of India|India]] (especially South Karnataka). It can be served with onion and garlic chutney.

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] ragi (finger [[Cookbook:Millet|millet]])
*2 cups [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Urad Bean|urad]] [[Cookbook:Dal|dal]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], to taste

==Procedure==

#Soak ragi, rice and urad dal separately in water for 5 hours. 
#Grind the soaked rice with water first and next with urad dal and ragi (both) with water.
#Mix up all the ground batter. Leave it for about 10 hours to [[Cookbook:Fermentation|ferment]]. 
#After 10 hours put some salt as per your taste to the batter and water if needed. 
#Take a cup of batter and spread it onto a hot [[Cookbook:Tava|tava]].
